Culsma driver for Opentrons, released alongside Culsma 1.0.11.

## Capabilities

- Connects Culsma programs and workstation configuration to the official Opentrons simulator for pipetting and supported plate movement.
- Supplies reference models for centrifugation and environmental holds, with source-linked capability checks and execution feedback.
- Implements configured high-precision pipetting methods and fresh-tip handling, and reports unsupported requests before device execution.
- Supports the complete whole-blood automation benchmark, including expected capability rejections and an injected execution failure.

This release is for software simulation. The repository is named `culsma-driver-opentrons`; the compatible Python distribution and CLI registration remain `culsma-opentrons-simulator` 0.1.0 and `opentrons-simulator`.

## Installation

```sh
python -m pip install 'culsma==1.0.11' 'culsma-opentrons-simulator @ git+https://github.com/culsma/culsma-driver-opentrons.git@v0.1.0'
```

Use Python 3.11 or 3.12. The [benchmark reproduction entry point](https://github.com/culsma/culsma/tree/v1.0.11/benchmarks/automation) prepares the recorded environment automatically.

## Validation

489 driver tests passed with the Culsma 1.0.11 wheel. All five automation scenarios passed. Wheel and source distributions passed metadata checks.
